title: Hooded figures spraying plague from landed craft
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Hooded figures spraying plague from landed craft, about 14th century at Europe, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: that Braramley did is that he found that the plague broke out only after these people would land in the fields, come out of these objects, land in, and they would go around with these hoods on and these spray cans that became the basis for the sid and the grim reaper image.
